text: dsh-toutiao-reader 是面向 DSH Web 的文章抓取插件，通过注册 webfetch 工具和 toutiao-reader 技能，让用户提交网页 URL 后获取标题与正文。它先尝试直连，遇到需要浏览器渲染的页面时转用 Edge 或 Chrome 的无头浏览器，并在 CDP 失败时采用 DOM 渲染兜底。返回结果包含抓取方式、标题、正文长度和截断状态；用户也可设置字符上限或将全文保存到指定文件。适合需要在 DSH 中阅读头条文章或普通网页全文的场景。浏览器抓取需要本机安装 Edge 或 Chrome；不需要 API Key。

dsh-toutiao-reader adds webfetch and a reading skill to DSH Web. Give it a page URL to return title and text. It tries direct requests, then headless Edge or Chrome with a DOM fallback. Set a character limit or save text to a file. Browser fetching needs Edge or Chrome locally; no API key is needed.
想在 DSH 里直接读取今日头条文章的正文
给我一个网页链接，帮我提取标题和全文
Fetch and return the full text of an article from its URL.
dsh-toutiao-reader 的功能「网页文章抓取」：webfetch 接收 http/https URL，自动尝试直连、无头浏览器和 DOM 渲染回退，返回标题、正文及实际抓取方式。
dsh-toutiao-reader 的功能「正文截断与保存」：调用 webfetch 时可设置 maxChars 限制返回长度，也可提供 outfile 将未截断全文写入文件，并返回截断状态和保存路径。
dsh-toutiao-reader 使用前须知：抓取会向用户提供的目标网页发送请求；头条链接会访问 www.toutiao.com，插件不要求 API Key。
dsh-toutiao-reader README · Introduction：

dsh-toutiao-reader README · dsh-toutiao-reader：[中文](README.zh.md) | English

**Packaged real-world experience of reading Toutiao (今日头条) articles as a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin**: a `webfetch` tool + a `toutiao-reader` skill.

```
model calls webfetch(url)
   ├─ ① direct-fetch        static direct ~1s (domain cache remembers which sites need a browser)
   ├─ ② resident Edge CDP   cold start ~20s once → resident on port 9333, then ~3-6s per fetch
   │     · reuses a persistent tab (saves ~4s)   · blocks images + ByteDance CDNs for speed

dsh-toutiao-reader README · Why：Toutiao's static HTML always trips its anti-bot layer (`__ac_nonce`/`__ac_signature`/`acrawler`) — a plain fetch gets a "security verification" page, and `web_search` only returns snippets. This plugin fills the gap: **give it an article URL, get back title + full plain text**. Tuned for Toutiao, and works for ordinary pages (blogs, news sites, anything reachable directly) too.

dsh-toutiao-reader README · Tool: `webfetch`：| Arg | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `url` | string, required | Article URL (PC pages at `www.toutiao.com/article/<id>/` work best; mobile/share pages are usually App-interstitials with no article text) |
| `maxChars` | number | Cap on returned text, default 12000, max 60000; sets `truncated` when cut |
| `outfile` | string | Optional: save full text to a file (title + blank line + body); absolute path, or relative to the `workspace` config |

dsh-toutiao-reader README · Tool: `webfetch`：Returns `{ method, title, text, textLength, truncated, outfile?, error? }`

- Failures come back as `{ error }` instead of throwing — fetching never breaks the main flow
- Declares `isConcurrencySafe: false` (CDP reuses one tab, so calls are forced sequential) and `timeoutMs: 120000`
- The `method` field tells you which tier served the request

dsh-toutiao-reader README · Skill: `toutiao-reader`：A bundled experience doc (model-invocable): Toutiao URL forms, reading the `method` field, challenge-page handling and retry pacing, troubleshooting short/empty bodies (video pages, Q&A pages, App interstitials), managing the resident headless browser (port/pid/stop command), network-environment notes, and the fallback script path.
dsh-toutiao-reader README · Option 1: the plugin market (recommended)：DSH Web → Settings → **Plugin Market** → search "toutiao" → install.

dsh-toutiao-reader README · Option 2: CLI：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-toutiao-reader
```

dsh-toutiao-reader README · Configuration：Use the **id-override mode** in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (id only — never re-insert):

```yaml
- id: dsh-toutiao-reader
  config:
    workspace: D:/DSH_Workspace  # base for relative outfile paths
    cdpPort: 9333                # CDP debugging port

dsh-toutiao-reader README · FAQ：**Slow fetches?** The first cold start of the resident browser takes ~20s; afterwards ~3-6s per fetch. Image blocking and ByteDance CDN filtering in the CDP tier are intentional speedups.

**Very short or empty text?** Usually a video page, Q&A page, or App interstitial (mobile share pages carry only ~40 chars of promo text in practice). Switch to the **PC URL** (`www.toutiao.com/article/<id>/`).

dsh-toutiao-reader README · FAQ：**Stuck in a challenge loop?** Wait a few seconds and retry once; avoid hammering (stricter risk control). Solved domains are remembered by the domain cache.

**Browser in a bad state?** Read `%TEMP%\webfetch-edge.pid`, then `taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F`; the next call cold-starts a fresh one.

dsh-toutiao-reader README · FAQ：**Already using a script?** The plugin **shares the resident browser and tab** with the workspace script `node tools/webfetch.mjs <url> [outfile]` (same pid/tab/profile files) — they accelerate each other; the script is the fallback path when the plugin is unavailable.

dsh-toutiao-reader README · Security & privacy：- Read-only fetching: writes nothing (unless you pass `outfile`), reads no credentials, phones nowhere
- The resident headless browser listens on localhost only (127.0.0.1)
- The domain cache stores a single string per domain (whether the site needs a browser) — no content is recorded

dsh-toutiao-reader README · Compatibility：- Requires local Edge or Chrome (auto-detected; override with `browserPath`)
- Node.js ≥ 20 (global fetch / WebSocket / AbortSignal.any); tested on DSH web 0.1.0-rc.6+
